name: toast
label: Toast
description: A global notification stack with progress bars, hover-to-pause, and four types. Trigger from JS, Blade sessions, or Livewire events. The stack is a polite aria-live region and every toast has a keyboard-accessible dismiss button.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long each toast stays visible, in milliseconds.

studio.card: <x-components.button variant="outline" size="sm" x-on:click="$dispatch('pop-toast', { message: 'Saved', type: 'success', description: 'Your changes are safe.' })">Show a toast</x-components.button>
studio.container: Pop a toast{{component}}

usage: Place <x-toast /> once in your layout. Then call toast('Saved!', 'success') in JS, dispatch a 'pop-toast' Livewire event, or flash session('toast').

examples.title: Types
examples.description: Click a button to pop a toast — success, error, warning or info.
